data.body: [P1] Protect latest selection against stale registry reads. Workflow serialization does not establish read freshness: after a release advances `latest` to `v3`, a queued `v2` run can observe the previous `v1` digest or a transient `ImageNotFoundException` and overwrite `latest` with `v2`. Verification then accepts the downgrade because it only requires `latest >= v2`. Persist a monotonic highest-published-version record in strongly consistent storage under the workflow lock, and use that record for reconciliation and verification. Add backport coverage for stale successful reads and transient missing-tag responses.
